_doc: SPEC §10 durable resume, issue #125. A run halts on a two-call relay turn; the host resumes with answerDeclined(pending.id, reason). Every outstanding call gets an error tool_result whose content is exactly `expect[i]`, in call order. Replayed by golang/relay_test.go and rust/tests/relay.rs — the two ports that ship the durable resume entry point.
